top_signals.title: Oil rises amid supply disruption fears following Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
